# apple_app_custom_product_pages (Data Source)

Lists an app's custom product pages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_custom_product_pages" "app" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `custom_product_pages` (Attributes List) The custom product pages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_product_pages))

<a id="nestedatt--custom_product_pages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_product_pages`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the custom product page.
- `name` (String) Reference name of the page.
- `url` (String) URL of the page on the App Store.
- `visible` (Boolean) Whether the page's URL opens the page.
